notes.title: Great news! Gecata 6 is here!
notes.content:
Here are the new features you’ll find in Gecata 6:
[list]
[*] Streaming: go live on Twitch or YouTube and create your own fan base
[*] New tutorial pop-ups for the hotkeys
[*] Smart, improved design
[*] Three languages added: Chinese Simplified, Italian, and Dutch
[/list]
